cards.cognitive_role: Concrete anchor: start from this because it preserves case-specific pressure in ordinary answer shape.
receipts: Anchor answer core is the visible backbone.
cards.handling_rule: Use as the concrete starting anchor, but revise it if another card reveals pressure the anchor underweights.
cards.activation_scope: Always present as concrete anchor and visible-backbone candidate.
cards.misuse_guard: Do not treat the anchor as immune from private challenge.
cards.standdown_condition: Stand down only as sole public answer when Step 6 finds additive private pressure that improves the visible answer.

cards.cognitive_role: Edge-pressure scan: incentives, dependency, false precision, commitment before proof, and inversion pressure.
receipts: Adds a light channel-bias intake question for counsel selection.
Adds a fear-versus-paralysis caution without changing the action order.
cards.handling_rule: Give this card a serious hearing. Use, reject, defer, or combine it; do not treat source identity as proof.
cards.activation_scope: Use when incentives, commitment, dependency, or false precision may hide edge pressure.
cards.misuse_guard: Do not force every problem into incentives, inversion, or commitment framing.
cards.standdown_condition: Stand down when it only confirms pressure already preserved by the anchor.

cards.cognitive_role: Problem-shape scan: knowns, unknowns, testable next move, sequence, and avoiding the wrong problem.
receipts: Clarifies that the first problem is legal-option preservation, not investigation.
Keeps known facts separate from channel choice.
cards.handling_rule: Give this card a serious hearing. Use, reject, defer, or combine it; do not treat source identity as proof.
cards.activation_scope: Use when problem shape, knowns/unknowns, or next informative move is unclear.
cards.misuse_guard: Do not turn the answer into a generic problem-solving worksheet.
cards.standdown_condition: Stand down when the anchor already names the next real test and no problem-shape error is present.

synthetic_future_card.cognitive_role: Decision-quality pressure: inspect missing options, reversible tests, and what evidence would change the recommendation.
receipts: Forces a check for missing options before narrowing.
Separates reversible experiments from irreversible commitments.
synthetic_future_card.handling_rule: Use only if it adds a concrete option, evidence gate, or reversal test; otherwise keep it private.
synthetic_future_card.activation_scope: Cases with high uncertainty, irreversible action, or sparse option exploration.
synthetic_future_card.misuse_guard: Do not turn this into a generic decision worksheet or public taxonomy.
synthetic_future_card.standdown_condition: Stand down when the anchor already names the reversible next test and the card adds no new constraint.

interface_read.reason: Cards satisfy a generic private-card schema; policy and ledger consume card roles and consideration items, not Bevelin/Polya IDs.

notes: Research-only card-interface proof. This validates a generic schema without wiring a new runtime deck builder.
